concept.object: a round glossy toy sun with a warm smiling glow
concept.morph: the sun squashes into an upright rounded rectangle and a single horizontal bar snaps across its middle
concept.hook: 太陽會像果凍一樣被壓扁，中間啪一聲多一橫

concept.object: a chunky crescent moon toy, soft cream colored
concept.morph: the crescent tilts upright and two short horizontal bars slide in from the left to fill it
concept.hook: 月亮站起來，兩條線咻咻滑進去

concept.object: three chunky toy mountain peaks in a row, the middle one tallest, snow caps on top
concept.morph: the three peaks straighten into three vertical strokes standing on one horizontal base
concept.hook: 三座山站直變成三根柱子

concept.object: a big glossy water droplet that lands and splashes
concept.morph: the splash arms fling outward into the left and right strokes while the core stretches into the central hook
concept.hook: 水滴啪一下炸開，變成字

concept.object: a friendly campfire flame with two little sparks popping beside it
concept.morph: the flame body folds into the central 人 shape while the two sparks drop into place as the side strokes
concept.hook: 火花啵啵兩下跳到旁邊

concept.object: a rounded mound of soil with a toy shovel stuck in it
concept.morph: the mound flattens into the bottom bar, the shovel handle stands as the vertical stroke, and a shorter bar snaps across
concept.hook: 鏟子插進土裡就變成字

concept.object: a small chunky toy tree with a straight trunk and two side branches
concept.morph: the branches droop into the two diagonal strokes and the roots spread into the base
concept.hook: 樹枝垂下來變成手手

concept.object: a rounded toy figure standing and walking on the spot
concept.morph: the arms and head retract while the two legs stretch into the two diagonal strokes
concept.hook: 小人把頭收起來，剩兩隻腳

concept.object: a wide open cartoon mouth, glossy and bouncy
concept.morph: the mouth stretches square and its outline thickens into the four strokes of a box
concept.hook: 嘴巴張超大變成方框

concept.object: a chunky five-fingered toy hand waving
concept.morph: the fingers merge downward into three stacked horizontal bars while the wrist stretches into the vertical hook
concept.hook: 五根手指疊成三條線

concept.object: a chubby toy foot taking one big stomp
concept.morph: the ankle lifts and squares off into the top box while the foot splits into the lower strokes
concept.hook: 腳踩一下，上面跳出一個框

concept.object: a big friendly cartoon eye that blinks twice
concept.morph: the eye rotates upright into a tall rectangle and two horizontal bars slide in across the pupil
concept.hook: 眼睛轉直，裡面多兩條線

concept.object: a soft rounded toy ear that wiggles
concept.morph: the ear straightens and its folds flatten into the stacked horizontal bars
concept.hook: 耳朵動一動就變平了

concept.object: a toy figure that inflates and throws both arms out wide
concept.morph: the outstretched arms become the top horizontal bar and the legs become the two big diagonals
concept.hook: 小人張開手手變好大

concept.object: three tiny glossy blocks, the middle one slightly taller with a hook
concept.morph: the two outer blocks tip outward into the side dots while the middle stretches into the hooked vertical
concept.hook: 三個小方塊，中間那個變長

concept.object: a chunky arrow springing upward off a flat baseline
concept.morph: the arrow shaft becomes the vertical stroke, its head flattens into the short bar, and the ground becomes the base line
concept.hook: 箭頭往上咻一下

concept.object: a chunky arrow dropping downward under a flat ceiling bar
concept.morph: the ceiling becomes the top bar, the shaft becomes the vertical, and the arrowhead shrinks into the side dot
concept.hook: 箭頭往下掉下來

concept.object: a glossy toy box with a rod spearing straight through its centre
concept.morph: the box squares into the rectangle and the rod stays as the vertical stroke through the middle
concept.hook: 棒子從正中間穿過去

concept.object: a toy figure with arms wide standing under a floating flat cloud-bar
concept.morph: the cloud bar drops onto the figure's arms making the two top bars, legs become the diagonals
concept.hook: 雲變成一條線壓在頭上

concept.object: a top-down toy farm field split into four green plots
concept.morph: the outer edge thickens into a box and the two dividing paths become the inner cross
concept.hook: 田裡的小路變成十字

concept.object: a plump toy cloud with four raindrops falling from it
concept.morph: the cloud flattens into the top bar and roof, and the four drops line up as the four inner dots
concept.hook: 四滴雨排排站進去

concept.object: a round boulder rolling off a small cliff ledge
concept.morph: the ledge becomes the top-left angled strokes and the boulder squares into the box beneath
concept.hook: 石頭從山邊滾下來

concept.object: three winding toy streams flowing side by side
concept.morph: the three streams straighten into three tall vertical strokes
concept.hook: 三條河變成三條直線

concept.object: a chubby round toy bird that hops and flaps once
concept.morph: the head and beak fold into the top strokes, the wing flattens into the stacked bars, and the feet spread into the four bottom dots
concept.hook: 小鳥的腳變成四個點點

concept.object: a plump toy fish wiggling in mid air
concept.morph: the head folds into the top strokes, the body squares into the middle grid, and the tail fin spreads into the bottom strokes
concept.hook: 魚尾巴啪一下變成底下的線

concept.object: a toy cow head with two curved horns, nodding
concept.morph: the horns flatten into the angled top stroke and the face stretches into the vertical with two crossbars
concept.hook: 牛角壓平變成一撇

concept.object: a fluffy toy sheep head with two curled horns
concept.morph: the curled horns open into the top dots and the face stacks into three horizontal bars
concept.hook: 羊角打開變成兩個點

concept.object: a galloping toy horse running on the spot
concept.morph: the mane becomes the top strokes, the body squares into the grid, and the four hooves become the four bottom dots
concept.hook: 馬的四隻腳變成四個點

concept.object: a happy toy puppy sitting and wagging its tail
concept.morph: the body opens into the 大 shape while one perked ear pops off as the small dot
concept.hook: 小狗的耳朵飛出去變成一點

concept.object: a glossy red toy heart beating with a soft thump
concept.morph: the heart splits open into the curved bowl and three little pieces pop up as the dots
concept.hook: 心臟跳一下就裂開了

concept.object: a chunky rounded toy knife, safe and cartoonish
concept.morph: the handle curves into the top hook and the blade sweeps into the long left stroke
concept.hook: 玩具刀刷一聲揮出去

concept.object: an archery bow being drawn and released
concept.morph: the bowstring snaps away and the bow limbs fold into the three stacked bends
concept.hook: 弓弦彈開，弓身摺三折

concept.object: a chunky toy car seen from directly above
concept.morph: the wheels flatten into the horizontal bars, the chassis becomes the centre box, and the axle stands as the vertical
concept.hook: 車輪壓平變成橫線

concept.object: a pair of chunky toy saloon doors swinging open
concept.morph: the two door panels straighten and lock into the left and right halves of the character
concept.hook: 兩扇門打開就是字

concept.object: a handful of glossy rice grains bursting outward in a star
concept.morph: the grains snap into place as four dots around a central cross
concept.hook: 米粒噴出來排成星星

concept.object: two chunky bamboo stalks side by side with leaves on top
concept.morph: the leaves fold down into the two short strokes and the stalks become the two vertical hooks
concept.hook: 竹葉往下摺兩下

concept.object: a bouncy toy flower blooming open on a short stem
concept.morph: the petals fold into the grass radical on top while the stem twists into the lower strokes
concept.hook: 花瓣收起來蓋在頭上

concept.object: a chunky toy arm flexing a big round muscle
concept.morph: the flexed arm sweeps into the hooked stroke and the forearm becomes the diagonal
concept.hook: 手臂用力一撇就是力

concept.object: An original tiny teal felt ninja and one rounded yellow toy camera with a telescoping lens.
concept.morph: Begin with the complete, correctly formed glyph. Its narrow left strokes expose the ninja's failed hiding attempt; a dense stroke junction on the right finally conceals his tiny felt body. The glyph never changes shape.
concept.hook: 布忍者想躲在「機」的細筆畫後面，相機卻看得一清二楚；最後他才找到右側密集筆畫後的小小藏身處。

concept.object: A rigid, indigo musical instrument shaped exactly like 器, with its four square openings preserved.
concept.morph: Begin with the complete glyph. Its four square openings function as air ports; all strokes remain rigid and correctly formed throughout.
concept.hook: 「器」變成一件奇妙樂器：海盜吹氣卻吹翹自己的鬍子，改用輕敲才奏出聲音。

concept.object: 忍者
concept.morph: Keep 忍 fully formed throughout: an accurately shaped 刃 above 心, with every dot and hook clearly separated. Animate the mouse and feather around the stationary glyph.
concept.hook: 帥氣的小老鼠忍者努力忍住噴嚏，鼓起的臉頰最後只吹出一小口氣，卻把大羽毛吹得翻跟斗。

concept.object: a stubby toy robot goalkeeper with oversized foam gloves, and a chunky soccer ball
concept.morph: the glyph 球 stands still as a solid sculpture while the goalkeeper gag plays out in front of its lower edge
concept.hook: 玩具機器人守門員擺出超認真的架式，飛撲出去撲了個空，足球慢悠悠地從他身下滾過去；他趴在地上抬頭看球，尷尬地比個讚。

concept.object: a small caped toy robot hero and a tiny wind-up toy tortoise
concept.morph: the glyph 超 stands still as a solid sculpture while the super-jump gag plays out along its base
concept.hook: 披紅斗篷的小玩具機器人蹲低要來個超級起飛，結果只彈起一點點；就在他不好意思的時候，一隻小烏龜玩具「咻」地高速從他旁邊衝過去，還回頭看他一眼。

concept.object: a chubby toy propeller plane with googly eyes
concept.morph: the glyph 飛 stands still as a solid sculpture while the take-off gag plays out in front of it
concept.hook: 胖胖的玩具飛機在原地猛催油門、機身抖個不停卻黏在地上；它洩氣地垂下機鼻，這時螺旋槳終於轉對邊，它整台倒著咻一聲飛出去。

concept.object: a small toy robot and a chunky cartoon battery
concept.morph: the glyph 電 stands still as a solid sculpture while the recharging gag plays out at its base
concept.hook: 沒電的小玩具機器人整個垮下來，手臂軟趴趴；一顆胖電池自己滾過來喀一聲插進他背後，他瞬間彈直、跳起一段超級浮誇的機器人舞，然後再度沒電垮掉。

concept.object: a stern toy robot referee and a tiny cartoon penguin
concept.morph: the glyph 笑 stands still as a solid sculpture while the trying-not-to-laugh gag plays out beside it
concept.hook: 一臉嚴肅的玩具機器人裁判努力板著臉，旁邊小企鵝玩具在平地上莫名其妙滑倒、四腳朝天；裁判的面板憋到裂出一道笑紋，最後整個抖起來無聲大笑，帽子都掉了。

concept.object: two chunky toy battle robots with soft rounded armour
concept.morph: the glyph 戰 stands still as a solid sculpture while the harmless showdown gag plays out along its base
concept.hook: 兩台胖胖的玩具戰鬥機器人擺出超浮誇的對決架式，慢慢逼近、拳頭舉高——結果兩顆頭「叩」一聲輕輕撞在一起，兩台同時彈開坐倒在地，然後互相伸手把對方拉起來、握個手。

concept.object: a stubby toy robot in a sweatband and a tiny toy snail
concept.morph: the glyph 跑 stands still as a solid sculpture while the running-on-the-spot gag plays out at its base
concept.hook: 矮胖玩具機器人卯足全力狂奔，腳步快到冒煙卻完全原地踏步；一隻小蝸牛玩具氣定神閒地從他前面慢慢爬過去，還停下來看他一眼。

concept.object: a stout cartoon detective pig in a deerstalker hat with a magnifying glass, and a trail of muddy hoofprints
concept.morph: the glyph 豬 stands still as a solid sculpture while the detective follows the hoofprints in a loop in front of it
concept.hook: 戴獵鹿帽的豬探長發現地上一排泥腳印，拿放大鏡一路跟蹤繞了一圈，越跟越興奮——最後停下來低頭一看，腳印正好接到自己的鞋子上，他整個僵住。

concept.object: a tiny toy robot, an absurdly oversized golden crown, and chunky interlocking plastic bricks
concept.morph: three long flat bricks settle into the three horizontal strokes and one upright brick drops through their centres to click into the vertical stroke of 王
concept.hook: 小玩具機器人戴上一頂大到離譜的金皇冠，整個人被罩住看不見，撞來撞去；他把皇冠推上去之後，三塊長積木疊好、一塊直積木從上面喀一聲插過去，變成「王」。

concept.object: a tiny toy robot and a gold medal bigger than he is
concept.morph: the medal ribbon opens into the peaked top of 金, three gold bars stack into the 王 beneath it, and two small gold beads drop into the gaps on either side
concept.hook: 小玩具機器人領到一面比他還大的金牌，努力舉高、越舉越高，最後被自己的獎牌壓得整個往後翻倒，躺在地上還把金牌高高舉著不放；金牌接著攤開變成「金」字的屋頂、三條金條和兩顆小金珠。

concept.object: a very small chubby toy dragon
concept.morph: the glyph 龍 stands still as a solid sculpture while the tiny dragon tries to breathe fire beside it
concept.hook: 一隻超小的玩具恐龍深吸一大口氣、身體鼓得像顆球，準備噴出驚天動地的火焰——結果只吐出一顆小泡泡，泡泡飄上去啪一聲破在牠自己鼻子上，牠還是超級得意地抬起頭。

concept.object: a small toy robot, a toy chest and a flood of chunky plastic bricks
concept.morph: the spilled bricks arrange into three bars crossed by one upright for the left 王 and two bars over two short legs for the right 元, forming 玩
concept.hook: 玩具機器人打開一個玩具箱，積木像瀑布一樣噴出來把他整個埋住，只剩一隻手伸在外面比讚；接著積木自己排好：左邊三橫一豎成「王」，右邊兩橫加兩隻小腳成「元」，合成「玩」。

concept.object: a toy robot artist with an oversized paintbrush
concept.morph: the glyph 畫 stands still as a solid sculpture while the paintbrush gag plays out beside it
concept.hook: 玩具機器人專心拿刷子作畫，刷子卡住後突然彈回來，在他自己臉上刷出一撇翹鬍子；他愣了一下，照照小鏡子，反而超滿意地摸摸鬍子鞠了個躬。

concept.object: a small toy robot, a chubby toy penguin and a little trampoline
concept.morph: the glyph 跳 stands still as a solid sculpture while the trampoline gag plays out along its base
concept.hook: 一台小玩具機器人和一隻胖企鵝站在小彈簧床兩端，機器人只是輕輕踩了一下，胖企鵝就被彈飛出畫面；等了好久好久，企鵝才慢慢掉回來，剛好端端正正坐好。

characters.meaning: to hit; to play (a ball game)

concept.object: a toy robot batter, a chunky bat and a ball
concept.morph: the flying bat lands upright as the 丁 on the right while three bricks slide in to form the 扌 radical on the left of 打
concept.hook: 玩具機器人擺出全壘打架式，使盡全力揮棒——球紋風不動地掉在地上，飛出去的是球棒；球棒直直插進地面變成「丁」，三塊積木滑過來排成提手旁，合成「打」。

concept.object: a toy robot with a chunky telescope and one small star toy
concept.morph: the glyph 星 stands still as a solid sculpture while the star quietly settles on the searching robot
concept.hook: 玩具機器人拿著望遠鏡到處找星星，翻來翻去都找不到；其實有一顆小星星早就悄悄飄到他頭上坐好，還轉頭對鏡頭揮揮手，他卻完全沒發現，繼續認真地找。

concept.object: a small toy robot and a chunky toy torch
concept.morph: the beam folds into the two dots and short upright on top, the torch body flattens into the horizontal bar, and the robot’s legs become the two strokes of 儿 below, forming 光
concept.hook: 玩具機器人打開一支胖手電筒，興奮地照來照去，最後不小心照到自己眼睛、瞇成一條線；他關掉手電筒後，光束收成上面的兩點與短豎，手電筒身體壓成中間那一橫，他的兩條腿則變成下面的「儿」，合成「光」。

concept.object: a small toy knight with a scabbard
concept.morph: the glyph 劍 stands still as a solid sculpture while the drawing-the-sword gag plays out beside it
concept.hook: 玩具騎士擺出超帥的架式緩緩拔劍，拔出來的卻是一支牙刷；他整個僵住、若無其事地把牙刷放回鞘裡，重新擺一次架式，這回才順利拔出真正的寶劍，帥氣地舉高敬禮。

concept.object: a chunky toy race car
concept.morph: the glyph 快 stands still as a solid sculpture while the race car overshoots and reverses back
concept.hook: 一台玩具賽車「咻」地衝過畫面消失，畫面外傳來撞進軟墊的悶悶一聲；接著它用極慢的速度倒車回到畫面中央，保險桿上還黏著一朵被撞下來的小花，它停好、抖了一下，花就掉下來。

concept.object: a cartoon toy centipede, a long row of tiny shoes and a small toy robot
concept.morph: the glyph 腳 stands still as a solid sculpture while the centipede struggles into its shoes below
concept.hook: 一隻卡通蜈蚣玩具坐在地上努力穿鞋，一隻、兩隻、三隻…穿到第五隻就累到整個癱平，後面還有一長排鞋子在等；一台小機器人走過來，默默幫牠穿上第六隻，牠感動地舉起一隻腳。

concept.object: a wind-up walking toy
concept.morph: the toy’s path settles into the 土 on top and the 龰 below, forming 走
concept.hook: 一個發條玩具人昂首闊步地往前走，發條轉到底後越走越慢，最後整個定格在抬腳的姿勢動彈不得；一隻手伸進來幫牠重新上緊發條，牠立刻「噠噠噠」精神抖擻地繼續走，走過的路線就變成「走」字。

concept.object: a small toy robot and a rice ball bigger than he is
concept.morph: the glyph 吃 stands still as a solid sculpture while the giant-bite gag plays out at its base
concept.hook: 玩具機器人面對一顆比他還大的飯糰，嘴巴張到不能再大、慢慢逼近，用力咬下去——結果只咬到一粒米；他把那粒米慢慢嚼完，認真地點點頭比出大拇指，好像剛吃完大餐。

concept.object: a small toy robot and a chunky cup with a bendy straw
concept.morph: the glyph 喝 stands still as a solid sculpture while the suction gag plays out beside it
concept.hook: 玩具機器人用吸管喝水，越吸越用力，臉頰整個凹下去，最後「啵」一聲整個杯子吸黏在他臉上拔不下來；他頂著杯子面無表情地站著，然後乾脆頂著杯子走掉。

concept.object: a toy owl and a small toy robot
concept.morph: the glyph 眼 stands still as a solid sculpture while the staring contest plays out below it
concept.hook: 一隻玩具貓頭鷹和一台小機器人進行瞪眼比賽，兩個都睜到最大、越靠越近；機器人先撐不住眨了一下，貓頭鷹得意地把頭整個轉了一圈，機器人只好認輸鼓掌。

concept.object: a small toy robot and a hat that never lands right
concept.morph: the glyph 頭 stands still as a solid sculpture while the hat gag plays out beside it
concept.hook: 小玩具機器人想戴上一頂帽子，帽子卻一直滑過頭頂掉到肩膀上、卡在手臂上、掛在腳邊；試了三次之後，他乾脆把頭抬高一點，帽子終於穩穩落在頭上，他立刻擺出超得意的姿勢。

concept.object: a small toy robot and a tiny toy house
concept.morph: the glyph 家 stands still as a solid sculpture while the robot moves into the little house beside it
concept.hook: 小玩具機器人蓋好一間迷你小屋，退後欣賞了一下，走到門口才發現門小到只能伸進一隻手；他想了想，直接把屋頂掀開、從上面爬進去，再從煙囪探出頭來開心地揮手。

concept.object: a small toy robot and a thick picture book
concept.morph: the glyph 書 stands still as a solid sculpture while the robot falls asleep under the book
concept.hook: 玩具機器人翻著一本厚書越看越入迷，頭一點一點地開始打瞌睡，書慢慢滑下來蓋在他臉上；他就這樣睡著發出小小的呼聲，每呼一次就有一頁被吹得掀起來又落下。

concept.object: a small toy robot, a little toy fruit tree and one big apple
concept.morph: the apple flattens into the 田 on top while the trunk and branches stretch into the 木 below, forming 果
concept.hook: 玩具機器人站在小果樹下張開雙手準備接蘋果，蘋果卻不偏不倚輕輕落在他頭頂上；他一動也不動地頂著蘋果站好，還慢慢比出一個讚，接著蘋果攤平成上面的「田」，樹幹伸展成下面的「木」，合成「果」。

concept.object: a tall toy giraffe, a short toy robot and a tiny tripod camera
concept.morph: the glyph 高 stands still as a solid sculpture while the mismatched pair try to fit into one photo
concept.hook: 一隻高高的玩具長頸鹿和一台矮矮的小機器人想一起拍合照，第一次長頸鹿的頭出了畫面，第二次機器人整個被擋住；最後長頸鹿乾脆整隻趴下來，兩個人臉貼臉終於剛剛好。

concept.object: a small toy robot, a bucket of black paint and a tiny rubber duck
concept.morph: the glyph 黑 stands still as a solid sculpture while the paint gag plays out at its base
concept.hook: 玩具機器人小心翼翼地端著一桶黑色顏料走路，在完全平坦的地上莫名絆了一下，整桶顏料倒扣在自己身上，全身變得黑漆漆只剩兩顆圓眼睛；旁邊的小鴨只被噴到一個黑點，低頭看了看，又抬頭看看他。
